bm_desc: AU Small Finance Bank Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Scrutinizers report of  Annual General Meeting held on September 05, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.

AU Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 25, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results of AU Small Finance Bank Limited for the quarter ended on June 30, 2026".
AU Small Finance Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
AU Small Finance Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting of AU Small Finance Bank Limited '.
